exposure: Fasting plasma glucose (FPG) levels during oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT)
cohort: The study included 33,417 women with singleton pregnancies who underwent a 75-g OGTT at 24-28 gestational weeks at the Obstetrics and Gynecology Hospital of Fudan University, Shanghai, China.
finding: Even at FPG levels lower than the IADPSG threshold, FPG was significantly associated with adverse perinatal outcomes, with different patterns of association observed in women with and without GDM.
mod_finding: Primary cesarean delivery was included as an adverse perinatal outcome in the composite endpoint, indicating an association with FPG levels.
